title: F05 · not_selected · Not Selected
lines: Eleven names on the list. Yours is not one of them.
He had practised every morning for a year.
Carrying water for the ones who got picked.
he told the moon it was not fair.
The whole world once leaned on the one who was sent away from the party.
Next match, their best bowler pulled a muscle in the first over.
Kabir was already warmed up. He always was.
Hold your corner until the world leans on it. That is sadhana.
